    stdlib/core/ops.cryo
==============================================================================
  struct Range<T>
  struct RangeInclusive<T>
  Range<T>: implements Iterator<T>
  RangeInclusive<T>: implements Iterator<T>
  Range::new(start: T, end: T) -> Range<T>
  RangeInclusive::new(start: T, end: T) -> RangeInclusive<T>

==============================================================================
std::core::option
    stdlib/core/option.cryo
==============================================================================
  enum Option<T>
  Option<T>: implements Clone
  Option<T>: implements Eq

==============================================================================
std::core::panic_unwind
    stdlib/core/panic_unwind.cryo
==============================================================================
  struct CatchCtx<T>
  struct PanicInfo
  __cryo_panic_taken_file() -> string
  __cryo_panic_taken_line() -> u32
  __cryo_panic_taken_message() -> string
  catch_unwind<T>(f: () -> T) -> Result<T, PanicInfo>
  run_catch_body<T>(data: u8*) -> void
  taken_panic_info() -> PanicInfo

  struct NonNull<T>
  NonNull.as_ptr(&this) -> T*
  NonNull.cast<U>(&this) -> NonNull<U>
  NonNull.offset(&this, count: i64) -> NonNull<T>
  NonNull::new(raw: T*) -> NonNull<T>

  enum Result<T, E>

==============================================================================
std::core::slice
    stdlib/core/slice.cryo
==============================================================================
  struct Slice<T>
  struct SliceIter<T>
  SliceIter<T>: implements Iterator<T>
  Slice.as_ptr(&this) -> T*
  Slice.get(&this, index: u64) -> Option<T> where T: Copy
  Slice.get_ref(&this, index: u64) -> Option<T*>
  Slice.is_empty(&this) -> boolean
  Slice.iter(&this) -> implement Iterator<T> where T: Copy
  Slice.length(&this) -> u64
  Slice.subslice(&this, start: u64, end: u64) -> Slice<T>
  Slice::from_raw(ptr: T*, length: u64) -> Slice<T>

  struct VaArgs
  VaArgs.as_ptr(&this) -> void*
  VaArgs.next<T>(&this) -> T where T: VaArg
  VaArgs::new(va: void*) -> VaArgs

  byte_at(s: Slice<u8>, index: u64) -> u8
  cleanup_opt_string(opt: Option<String>) -> void
  data_fragment(fr: &Frame) -> Slice<u8>
  header_fragment(fr: &Frame) -> Slice<u8>
  is_pseudo(name: Str) -> boolean
  is_skippable(name_lower: Str) -> boolean
  preface_bytes() -> Slice<u8>
  push_all(out: Array<u8>*, bytes: Slice<u8>) -> Result<(), IoError>
  read_u31(s: Slice<u8>) -> u32
  slice_eq(a: Slice<u8>, b: Slice<u8>) -> boolean
  write_u31(out: u8*, value: u32) -> void
  Http2Connection.connection(mut &this) -> BufStream<S>*
  Http2Connection.drop(mut &this) -> void
  Http2Connection.encode_regular_headers(mut &this, out: mut &Array<u8>, h: &Headers) -> void
  Http2Connection.encode_response_headers(mut &this, out: mut &Array<u8>, resp: &Response) -> void
  Http2Connection.goaway_seen(&this) -> boolean
  Http2Connection.process_control(mut &this, fr: &Frame) -> Result<boolean, IoError>
  Http2Connection.queue_ack_data(mut &this, stream_id: u32, n: u64) -> Result<(), IoError>
  Http2Connection.queue_settings(mut &this) -> Result<(), IoError>
  Http2Connection::new_client(conn: BufStream<S>) -> Http2Connection<S>
  Http2Connection::new_server(conn: BufStream<S>) -> Http2Connection<S>

  struct Instant
  struct SystemTime
  Instant: implements Eq
  Instant: implements Ord
  FILETIME_NS_PER_TICK: i64
  FILETIME_TICKS_PER_SEC: i64
  FILETIME_TO_UNIX_TICKS: i64
  I64_MAX: i64
  NSEC_PER_SEC: i64
  read_monotonic() -> Instant   [private]
  read_realtime() -> SystemTime   [private]
  sleep(dur: Duration) -> void
  sleep_for(dur: Duration) -> void   [private]
  Instant.as_nanos(&this) -> i64
  Instant.checked_add(&this, dur: &Duration) -> Option<Instant>
  Instant.checked_sub(&this, dur: &Duration) -> Option<Instant>
  Instant.duration_since(&this, earlier: &Instant) -> Duration
  Instant.elapsed(&this) -> Duration
  Instant.saturating_duration_since(&this, earlier: &Instant) -> Duration
  Instant::now() -> Instant
  SystemTime.checked_add(&this, dur: &Duration) -> Option<SystemTime>
  SystemTime.duration_since(&this, earlier: &SystemTime) -> Duration
  SystemTime.duration_since_epoch(&this) -> Duration
  SystemTime.unix_secs(&this) -> i64
  SystemTime::from_unix_secs(secs: i64) -> SystemTime
  SystemTime::now() -> SystemTime
  SystemTime::unix_epoch() -> SystemTime

  struct Duration
  Duration: implements Debug
  Duration: implements Display
  Duration: implements Eq
  Duration: implements Ord
  MICROS_PER_SEC: u64
  MILLIS_PER_SEC: u64
  NANOS_PER_MICRO: u64
  NANOS_PER_MILLI: u64
  NANOS_PER_SEC: u64
  U64_MAX: u64
  copy_str(buf: u8*, pos: u64, s: Str) -> u64   [private]
  Duration.as_micros(&this) -> u64
  Duration.as_millis(&this) -> u64
  Duration.as_nanos(&this) -> u64
  Duration.as_secs(&this) -> u64
  Duration.as_secs_f64(&this) -> f64
  Duration.checked_add(&this, other: &Duration) -> Option<Duration>
  Duration.checked_sub(&this, other: &Duration) -> Option<Duration>
  Duration.divide(&this, divisor: u64) -> Duration
  Duration.is_zero(&this) -> boolean
  Duration.mul_f64(&this, factor: f64) -> Duration
  Duration.saturating_add(&this, other: &Duration) -> Duration
  Duration.saturating_sub(&this, other: &Duration) -> Duration
  Duration.scale(&this, factor: u64) -> Duration
  Duration.subsec_micros(&this) -> u32
  Duration.subsec_millis(&this) -> u32
  Duration.subsec_nanos(&this) -> u32
  Duration.to_debug_string(&this) -> String
  Duration.to_string(&this) -> String
  Duration::from_micros(micros: u64) -> Duration
  Duration::from_millis(millis: u64) -> Duration
  Duration::from_nanos(nanos: u64) -> Duration
  Duration::from_secs(secs: u64) -> Duration
  Duration::from_secs_f64(secs: f64) -> Duration
  Duration::microsecond() -> Duration
  Duration::millisecond() -> Duration
  Duration::nanosecond() -> Duration
  Duration::new(secs: u64, nanos: u32) -> Duration
  Duration::second() -> Duration
  Duration::zero() -> Duration
